material.source: provisional; workbench profile h2d-engineering/pla.json. Final material not chosen.

orientation.bed_face: back of the carrier, XY at Z=0
orientation.reason: pocket opens upwards; jaws, ledge and rails are vertical walls

fits: plug overmold to jaws: 0.2 mm total interference (PLUG_SQUEEZE); plug measured by the user on 2026-11-16
latch to overmold face 0.1 mm (LATCH_GAP_PLUG), latch to the housing flat 0.25 mm (LATCH_GAP_DEV), latch slot to metal shell 0.25 mm per side (LATCH_CLEAR)
loads: USB-C unmating force 8 to 20 N per the USB-C spec pulls the overmold face against the latch; latch bears on a 0.6 to 0.75 mm rim of the face; not calculated
physical_tests: DONE 2026-11-17 (earlier, smaller carrier): plug presses in between ledge and latch by hand
DONE 2026-11-17 (earlier, smaller carrier): plug stays in the carrier when the device is pulled out
DONE 2026-11-17 (earlier, smaller carrier): device charges with the plug sitting 1.25 mm lower (insertion 4.9 mm instead of 6.2 mm)
PENDING: the Apple plug sits firmly in the larger carrier (the bay roof is now 1.7 mm above the plug instead of 0.3 mm; the jaws alone hold it) and stays when the device is pulled out

limits: Probes test small boxes with 98% solid / at most 2% material for empty; no general feature recognition.
Wall checks sample named cross-sections; no global minimum-wall guarantee.
Material, load capacity, physical fit, orientation and support require separate evidence.
